description: This file defines the 'app' package for Mattermost, implementing the 'App' struct which provides access to various server components, services, and configurations. It includes methods for retrieving server info, managing system data, and interfacing with external services.

classes.name: App
classes.description: A request-scoped component providing access to server services and business logic.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Constructs a new App instance with optional configurations.

methods.name: TemplatesContainer
methods.description: Returns the server's HTML templates container.

methods.name: getFirstServerRunTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the timestamp of the first server run from system data.

methods.name: Channels
methods.description: Returns the Channels associated with the App.

methods.name: Srv
methods.description: Returns the Server associated with the App.

methods.name: AccountMigration
methods.description: Provides access to account migration interface.

methods.name: DataRetention
methods.description: Provides access to data retention interface.

methods.name: SearchEngine
methods.description: Provides access to the search engine broker.

methods.name: DBHealthCheckWrite
methods.description: Writes a health check timestamp to the database.

methods.name: DBHealthCheckDelete
methods.description: Deletes the health check entry from the database.

methods.name: dbHealthCheckKey
methods.description: Generates the database health check key.

methods.name: CheckIntegrity
methods.description: Performs an integrity check on the database.

methods.name: SetChannels
methods.description: Sets the Channels for the App.

methods.name: SetServer
methods.description: Sets the Server for the App.

methods.name: PropertyAccessService
methods.description: Provides access to property management service.

methods.name: UpdateExpiredDNDStatuses
methods.description: Updates expired Do Not Disturb statuses.
